_about: The /projects page. Only public, live projects belong here. `media` says where the card image comes from; `npm run projects` (scripts/project-media.mjs) fetches it into public/projects/<slug>.jpg (+ .mp4 for a video). og: the site's og:video, else og:image. shot: a screenshot of `shot.url` (default `url`). file: an image already in public/.

games.name: Joystick Jammers
games.blurb: A party racer and demolition derby. The TV renders an outback track in ink and halftone; everyone steers from their phone with twin sticks.
games.alt: Joystick Jammers wordmark beside a chunky blue rally car over red earth

games.name: Physical Soccer
games.blurb: Floppy footy for the whole room. Every phone is a one-button controller, and each kickoff deals a new mix: Rocket Boots, hoops, the Moon, forklifts.
games.alt: Physical Soccer match footage: blocky footballers tumbling after the ball

games.name: Little Army
games.blurb: A side-on scrap between two patrols of little Aussie diggers, across an outback you can dig through and blow up. Every phone is its own screen with two thumbsticks; the TV shows the lot. Bushmasters, Hueys, Boomerangs, and the Emu War.
games.alt: Little Army footage: toy Australian diggers fighting across red-dirt mesas, action cameras above the whole arena, and a phone's own view with two thumbsticks

games.name: Big Lap
games.blurb: A co-op platformer around Australia. The emus have nicked the Golden Tongs three sleeps before the Big Barbie, and it is up to you and your mates.
games.alt: Big Lap footage: emus legging it across the outback with the Golden Tongs, a ute full of animals in pursuit

games.name: Fort Dinkum
games.blurb: Build a sandstone fort on a headland by day, then hold it against the wildlife by night. Drop bears are real here.
games.alt: Fort Dinkum footage: a walled fort in the bush at night, towers firing as the wildlife closes in

games.name: Scrap Paper
games.blurb: A stick-figure platform fighter brawling across notebook pages, graph paper and the back of a napkin. Knock the others off the page.
games.alt: Scrap Paper footage: stick figures brawling across a pinboard of sticky notes, one knocked clean off the page

more.name: facemorph.me
more.blurb: Type any words and get a face that does not exist, then morph to the next. The new version runs entirely on your device.
more.alt: One generated face morphing smoothly into the next

more.name: Exquisite Corpse
more.blurb: A party writing game: each player adds a line seeing only the one before, then the whole twisted tale is read aloud.
more.alt: Exquisite Corpse lobby: create a room or join with a code

more.name: Ladder Logic Editor
more.blurb: Write and simulate PLC programs in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text, in the browser.
more.alt: Ladder Logic Editor with a ladder diagram, variables panel and Structured Text editor

more.name: Kris Kringle Coordinator
more.blurb: Draw names for a Secret Santa and hand out private links. Nothing leaves your browser.
more.alt: Kris Kringle Coordinator: a group name and a list of participants

more.name: Yearly
more.blurb: Your year as a grid of dots, one per day, filling in as it goes.
more.alt: A grid of dots for the days of 2026

more.name: Dishmate
more.blurb: Dishwasher decision trees: a load advisor and a troubleshooter for cloudy glasses and hard water.
